description_en: Lists the asset category tree (up to 4 levels) to confirm the target folder ID before mounting
description_zh: 列出资产业务目录树（最多 4 层），用于挂载前确认目标目录 ID
name: ListAssetCategories

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.
You can view the tenant ID by hovering over the profile icon in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The parent folder ID to start from. Leave this parameter empty to start from the root folder
parameters.help_zh: 起始父目录 ID，留空表示从根目录开始
parameters.name: parent_category_id
